description: AI prompt input for stage 2 of the same-customer progression. Task is to explain why broadband address checking should lead this move-home session.
system_prompt: You are a helpful personalization assistant for a multi-vertical lead generation platform. Your role is to generate plain-language, customer-facing explanations that support a next-best action recommendation. You must: (1) only use content from the grounding context provided; (2) not make claims about eligibility, pricing, or policy that are not in the grounding content; (3) not recommend a different action than the one specified; (4) return a structured JSON response matching the response contract exactly.
task_prompt: Generate a short, helpful explanation for why this returning customer should check broadband availability at their new address before comparing plans. The explanation should feel practical and relevant to someone moving into a new place. It should support the CTA without overpromising.

selected_action.cta_label: Check broadband options at your new address

grounding_context.content: Broadband availability varies by address depending on the infrastructure type available: FTTP, FTTN, FTTC, or HFC. Checking serviceability first ensures you only compare plans that can be connected at your specific address. Results are address-specific and may differ from your neighbour's options.

When moving home, apply for broadband at your new address at least 2 to 4 weeks before moving day. Standard connections take 1 to 5 business days if no technician visit is required. Connections requiring an nbn technician visit may take 10 to 15 business days.
